decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings build directly on the firm's core drainage engineering and manufacturing know-how, and they were presented prominently on their own page, so the firm can interpret results and refine them.
Floor-level shower drainage is the firm's central competence and strategic direction, and its rising visibility from a mention to its own page signals successful assimilation.
Designer shower drains fit the firm's design-quality positioning and existing product families, although their reduced prominence in 2019 suggests possible replacement by newer variants.
A shower element with integrated slope fits the trend toward integrated, low-profile accessible systems and relies on existing waterproofing knowledge, though it has only been mentioned so far.
The backflow-protected cellar drain was developed in-house, promoted on the home page, and extends proven drainage technology, which makes it a well-absorbed product with clear value.
The air-admittance valve is a complementary sanitary accessory that sits further from the core drain competence and has low visibility, but as a cheap system add-on it is still likely retained.
